answer: The fee is charged through a willow debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the gale totals, and the lotus anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 20 units per epoch, sustaining 364 aliases for 42 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the adversary. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 35 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
